value.answer: Sorry you're needing one, that's a good step. Here's where to start in Toronto. For free or cheap help, Family Service Toronto has counselling on a sliding scale based on income, and the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term CBT for depression and anxiety. ConnexOntario is free and open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600 if you want referrals. For a private therapist, Psychotherapy Referral Service matches you with registered psychotherapists, and First Session offers free consultations. A private session runs about $160, per one source, and many employer extended health plans cover it. If things get urgent, Distress Centres of Greater Toronto offers free 24/7 support by hotline, chat or text.
